note: The ASHRAE committee describes the protocol’s data, command and status exchanges among building automation devices and explicitly includes HVAC.
The project describes both the XML database and XQuery processor, including storage and querying of XML documents. XML is a core capability, not the only supported data format.
The specification’s Abstract and §1 describe emulating a long-lived bidirectional connection through several synchronous HTTP request/response pairs.
The archived official 2.79a API documents game scenes, action controls and logic bricks connected to the Blender interface. This supports the legacy product sense.
RFC 1994 specifies peer authentication by a challenge and a response dependent on a shared secret that neither party sends across the link.
The official overview calls CocoaPods a dependency manager for Cocoa projects and describes integration through an Xcode project and workspace.
Microsoft describes the DXVA API and driver interface, and explains that codecs and video processors can offload work to the GPU.
Sections 4 and 6 explain DO-178C lifecycle objectives, activities and evidence for airborne software. FAA treats it as an acceptable means, not itself a regulation.
CableLabs identifies the document as a member of the DOCSIS high-speed data-over-cable specification family and depicts the cable modem linked to the operator’s broadband access network.
Google’s archived specification describes Bluetooth Low Energy proximity beacon messages and their frame formats. This does not establish support for any associated cloud service.
RFC 9639 defines a lossless format for digital audio. Lossless reconstruction refers to the encoded audio samples, not necessarily all metadata or container bytes from a source file.
RFC 3650 explains persistent handles and resolution independent of location. A moved resource remains reachable when its binding is maintained.
